The patch diff shows moving `platform_set_drvdata(pdev, dsi);` and `init_waitqueue_head(&dsi->irq_wait_queue);` to before `mipi_dsi_host_register(&dsi->host);`. The crash trace confirms the NULL dereference originates from `mtk_dsi_bind` during encoder initialization.
